prompt: Rewarded ads need a per-save daily limit. A save may carry `rewardLimit`, an integer from 1 to 10, that replaces the default daily limit of 3 wherever the daily rewarded-ad allowance applies: the quota status, crediting an ad reward, and clamping the saved rewardDay count when progress is read. Reading progress must keep a valid `rewardLimit` and drop an invalid one, and saved ad grants for the extra rewards (ad indices up to 9) must survive reading. Missing or invalid values keep the default of 3. Keep the exported default limit constant and all other economy behavior unchanged.

Rename the calendar-day validator `validDay` to `isCalendarDay` everywhere in the game sources: its export and every import and call. Do not leave a `validDay` alias or reference. Behavior must stay identical.

Heroes can now carry their own depth half-thickness: `player.depthBodyHalf`, a positive finite number, replaces the fixed hero half depth in every depth contact test, both the swept test and the supports held during a running depth transfer. Without a valid value the existing constant applies. Keep the constant exported, the all-planes span and per-object half depths unchanged.
